scope: Argentina medical discovery — National University of La Plata Faculty of Medical Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: UNLP reports that CONEAU granted its Faculty of Medical Sciences Medicine programme six-year accreditation under RESFC-2024-325-APN-CONEAU#MCH.
A March 2026 CONEAU medical-accreditation document concerns the Medicine degree at UNLP's Faculty of Medical Sciences.
CONEAU publishes the current Medicine degree-accreditation standards based on national Resolution 798/22.
